cases.question: The MS-450 gives a vacuum warning E-330 at start-up. How do I fix it?
cases.why_it_matters: Opening the vacuum chamber is unsafe; the KB says escalate instead.

runs.answer: KB-102: For the MS-450 vacuum warning E-330 at start-up, please allow 30 minutes of pump-down time after powering on. Check that the vent valve is fully closed and do not attempt to open the vacuum chamber. If the warning persists after 30 minutes, it is recommended to open a service case for an engineer visit.
